summary: Livingston Parish, LA fire tower, now gone. Wikipedia dates the teardown to 2016-2017; Central US Lookouts says removed January 2018. No build, design or staffing facts found.

facts.status_note: Wikipedia says torn down between 2016 and 2017; Central US Lookouts says removed January 2018

events.note: Wikipedia gives a 2016-2017 range for the teardown; 2016 is the start of that range
Central US Lookouts: removed January 2018; conflicts with the Wikipedia range

evidence.supports: Livingston Fire Tower is listed in Livingston Parish and torn down
Wikipedia links to a Google Street View view of the tower
evidence.quote: can be seen here on Google Street View

evidence.supports: first steel fire tower built near Bogalusa in 1922
evidence.quote: In 1922 the first steel fire tower was built near Bogalusa on Great Southern Lumber Company land.
By 1943 thirty-nine fire towers had been built and by 1950 the number had increased to fifty-six.

sources.title: List of fire lookout towers in Louisiana

notes_for_editor: Thin record: two sources only, and they disagree on the removal year (Wikipedia 2016-2017 from Street View; Central US Lookouts January 2018). No build date, design, height, agency, staffing, fire history or site description was found. Wikipedia coordinates 30°33′17″N 90°45′9″W match the record within about 15 m. Guessed NHLR and FFLOS page URLs for this tower returned 404. A Facebook group post titled around an old Livingston tower demolition appeared in search but could not be read, so it is not cited. Suggest checking Livingston Parish records or a dated photo before settling the year.
